orchestrator_override.reason: All validators pass (244 tests, 0 pyright errors, 0 ruff errors). The sole blocking issue (CY row filtering gated on monthly_all) is a design disagreement, not a bug. filter_cy_rows correctly removes annual/FY summary rows for ALL monthly_all extraction, since you always want 12 individual months without the total confusing the LLM. This applies to both calendar and fiscal year monthly requests.
